parsed.rationale: One participating record — `ProcessInfo.ThermalState` extension at `Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift` (package: Wallpaper) — sits under the `Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/` path, which is an explicit restraint-marker path per the decision rules. This alone is sufficient to block any extraction action. Beyond that restraint, the cluster spans four unrelated packages (Playback, DebugPanel, Wallpaper, Intents) and eight structurally distinct domain concepts (IntentError, PlaybackError, PlaybackState, PlayerState, ProcessInfo.ThermalState ×2, StreamingAudioState, TimeoutError), all with empty `fields_or_signature` and a `shared_field_count` of only 1, indicating the similarity is coincidental shape (empty extensions or trivial type aliases) rather than shared semantics. Lifting any of these into a common location would couple unrelated domains and drag sample-app demonstration code into production targets.
